requirement_text: Nightly maintenance completes at least every 26 h; a missed run alerts within one grace window

heartbeat.name: Postern nightly maintenance (03:05 UTC)
heartbeat.ping_source: HttpJobHeartbeat, called only after the maintenance audit entry is committed
heartbeat.configuration: Healthchecks__PingUrl (Worker env / Render secret); URL itself is not stored in the repo

caveats: The heartbeat is configured outside the repository; source can evidence the ping and its tests, not the alert delivery.
No missed runs can be claimed until the first full window closes; the matrix actual stays 'first ping 17 Nov 2026'.
